# Improvement plan: feature-interaction-rich TabM + GBDT stack

## Tier classification: Tier 2 (Representation & Components)

**Why this Tier:** The pipeline is already a well-engineered TabM(GELU/LayerNorm/rank-1 heads)+HistGradientBoosting blend, yet OOF MLP (≈0.75) and GBDT (≈0.75) are both near the same ceiling — indicating the bottleneck is *representation* (what each model sees), not *optimization* (how they're trained). Per the strategy, tuning epochs/lr/wd is Tier 1 and forbidden here; the safest high-leverage change is adding task-specific feature structure plus a stronger tree-side component, while leaving the honest CV / OOF / fresh-process scaffolding untouched.

## Components to change (max 4)

1. **data_processing_and_feature_engineering** — richer leakage-safe representation.
2. **model_design** — replace GBDT anchor branch with a stronger, complementary booster.
3. **training_evaluation** — stack via logistic meta-learner on OOF probabilities instead of a single hand-picked blend weight.
4. **Model-diversity plumbing** — persist the new branch artifacts and keep the fresh-process contract intact.

## WHAT will change

**(a) Feature engineering (leakage-safe).** Extend `FeatureEngineer._base`/`_combos` with: (i) *restaurant-usage aggregate* — a single ordinal "dining out frequency" score plus its missingness indicator (the 5 Bar/Coffee/CarryAway/Restaurant<20/Restaurant20-50 columns are highly correlated proxies of the same latent behavior and are currently only summed); (ii) *coupon×destination-target compatibility flags* — e.g. does the customer's frequency for the offered coupon's venue type sit above/below their own mean usage (a within-row normalized deviation, so no global stats are needed); (iii) *distance × coupon-type interaction* encoded ordinally (coupon=Bar + distance>15min is a known low-acceptance regime); (iv) a few extra cross-categorical target-encodings (`coupon×direction`, `coupon×expiration×time`), keeping OOF encoding exactly as today. All of these use only per-row arithmetic or fold-internal statistics, so validation purity is preserved.

**(b) GBDT branch upgrade (Tier-2 model component).** Swap HistGradientBoosting for a 3-seed LightGBM-style bagged booster (fall back to HistGB if LightGBM is unavailable), configured with higher `num_leaves`, lower `learning_rate`, and `min_child_samples` tuned to the ~8k rows. The GBDT branch is what currently anchors the blend; giving it richer categorical handling (native categorical + higher capacity) is a genuine model-component change, not a hyperparameter tweak of the MLP. I will also add a second, shallow GBDT with **different cat-encoding** (target-encoded numerics instead of ordinals) to increase diversity for the stack.

**(c) Stacking instead of a scalar blend.** Today `best_w` is a 1-D grid on OOF — extremely low-capacity and prone to noise. Replace with a *constrained* logistic-regression meta-learner trained on OOF probability vectors `[p_mlp, p_lgb]` (2 features + intercept), fit on OOF only (never touching the held-out supervisor split). This is still OOF-only and honest, but extracts more signal from branch disagreement and naturally handles the class prior.

**(d) Plumbing.** Persist LGB encoders/models/meta-learner under `--model`; adjust `predict` to load them and reproduce the stack deterministically. No refits at predict time; row order preserved; `row_id,prediction` output untouched.

## WHY these changes (root cause)

The plateau at ~0.7527 with two near-identical branch accuracies strongly suggests all branches are capturing the same coarse signal (coupon type, demographics, distance) and failing on *interaction regimes* (Bar+far, cheap-restaurant+near, coffee+morning) that are known to dominate coupon acceptance. The current 3 TE sources miss these; the 5 dining-frequency columns are only summed, wasting their within-row structure; and a 1-D blend weight can't exploit branch disagreement. These are representation/component gaps, not training-schedule gaps.

## HOW (high-level)

Implement (a) as pure additions inside existing methods so saved `FeatureEngineer` pickles remain backward-compatible. Add (b) as a new module `build_lgb`/`LGBEncoder` reusing the existing `GBDTFeatureEncoder` interface with an added target-encoded numeric variant; keep HistGB as fallback. Replace the blend grid with a 2-feature logistic meta-learner fit on OOF, clipped for stability. Wire (c)+(d) into `cmd_train`/`cmd_predict` with the same artifact paths and fresh-process reload discipline. All evaluation still reports honest OOF accuracy as `Final Validation Score`; supervisor accuracy remains the only external signal.
